our_differentiators.title: Silent-station detection with predictive maintenance
our_differentiators.detail: Flags a dead station within minutes and predicts failure from health-score trends - directly targets the Gurugram 2018 incident where a 20-25 day outage caused a missed 128mm rainfall event.

our_differentiators.title: Tampering detection with an honest fallback
our_differentiators.detail: Neighbor-station comparison catches insurance-fraud-style tampering (the documented Maharashtra case); falls back to a station's own history when no neighbors are available.

our_differentiators.title: Explainable, multi-layer fusion
our_differentiators.detail: Combines rules, physics checks, spatial comparison, and ML into one attribution with a transparent confidence score - not a black box.

our_differentiators.title: Role-based routing matching real IMD structure
our_differentiators.detail: Notification routing mirrors actual IMD organizational roles (DDG, Regional Meteorological Centre officers, Instrumentation Division, Forecasting Office) rather than generic admin/user labels.

our_differentiators.title: Tested on both synthetic and real data
our_differentiators.detail: Synthetic mode proves detection accuracy against known faults; real mode (Open-Meteo) proves real-world stability; hybrid mode combines both for the strongest available test.

honest_limitations: Precision cannot be honestly computed on real-world data without real IMD ground-truth fault records - only recall against our own synthetic faults is reported.
No live radar/satellite integration built in; Open-Meteo's data already blends satellite and ground sources, documented as the reasoning for not duplicating this.
Full production hardening (server redundancy, encrypted database, audit logging, legal/DPDP Act compliance review) is future-deployment scope, not claimed as done.
